sql:
with ex as (select id,key,state from experiments where key in ('mmsell-price-ceiling','mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity','mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap','mmsell-price-ceiling-size-split','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size','mmsell-win-set','mmsell-win-set-2')),
lv as (select distinct on (v.experiment_id) v.experiment_id, v.id vid, v.version from experiment_versions v join ex on ex.id=v.experiment_id order by v.experiment_id, v.version desc)
select ex.key, ex.state, lv.version as latest_v, ep.epoch_number, (ep.ended_at is null) ep_open, ev.version as dep_v, d.deployment_key, d.kind, d.stage, d.ended_at, da.strategy_tag,
 (select max(created_at) from live_orders lo where lo.strategy=da.strategy_tag) last_live,
 (select max(created_at) from paper_trades pt where pt.strategy=da.strategy_tag) last_paper,
 (select string_agg(g.gate_key||'='||coalesce((select r.verdict from experiment_gate_results r where r.gate_id=g.id order by r.id desc limit 1),'-'),' | ') from experiment_gates g where g.version_id=lv.vid and g.superseded_by_gate_id is null) gates
from ex join lv on lv.experiment_id=ex.id
join experiment_versions ev on ev.experiment_id=ex.id
join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id=ev.id
join experiment_deployments d on d.epoch_id=ep.id
left join experiment_deployment_arms da on da.deployment_id=d.id
where d.ended_at is null or ep.ended_at is null
order by ex.key, d.kind, d.deployment_key
